expectedRealization.rationale: 5G policy acceleration and operator capex should appear in orders and earnings over the next one to two reporting cycles; 60d is the pre-registered base horizon.

acceptableExpressionSet.rationale: Direct telecom-equipment exposure, strong 2019 operator-network growth and cash flow, but the theme had already rerated materially and 2020 valuation still required continued 5G execution.

changeHypothesis.summary: Official policy explicitly accelerated 5G buildout just as ZTE's 2019 operator-network revenue and cash flow had recovered strongly. The unresolved issue is whether a widely followed 5G narrative still leaves enough incremental earnings room.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Carrier 5G rollout is multi-quarter, but global COVID supply/demand risk can disturb deployment.
disconfirmingEvidence: The 5G basket had already outperformed CSI300 strongly over 60d.
ZTE itself had underperformed the benchmark over the final 20d.
The March 31 forecast already embedded multi-year EPS growth.

causalChain.mechanism: Operators deploy radio/core/network equipment as policy and capex accelerate.
Operator-network revenue is the company's largest directly exposed segment and had already grown strongly in 2019.

falseThemeMatches: 5G concept stocks without material operator-network revenue

earningsSensitivity.favorable: 5G rollout drives revisions above the frozen path.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: Global deployment/supply disruption prevents forecast delivery.

matchedControls.name: 烽火通信
matchedControls.fairCounterfactualReason: Direct telecom-network peer in the same 5G buildout.
matchedControls.whySelectedCompanyShouldOutperform: ZTE has stronger frozen first-party earnings/cash-flow evidence and a quantified current earnings path.

matchedControls.fairCounterfactualReason: Optical-component expression exposed to the same 5G capex cycle.

selectionComparison.rationale: ZTE is a sound direct expression, but exact peer ranking is not required; prior rerating and execution risk keep it at Research.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The 5G basket had +25.8pp 60d benchmark excess; March 31 research forecast strong EPS growth and used 40x 2020 PE as a valuation anchor.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Policy acceleration can generate estimate upgrades if domestic deployment converts faster than the already-positive baseline.
expectations.measurableGap: Real earnings/cash-flow recovery exists, but the opportunity is not clearly under-owned enough for Primary.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward EPS path versus 5G-cycle valuation and prior relative-price absorption.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: 2020/21/22 EPS 1.30/1.74/2.35; research used 40x 2020 PE for target valuation.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Domestic 5G orders and operator-network margins drive estimates above the frozen path.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Earnings upgrades must offset a theme that already rerated strongly in Q1.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: 5G rollout proceeds but merely meets the widely anticipated earnings path.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Operator tenders, order wins and Q1/H1 results are near-term observable catalysts.

fundamentalAcceleration.rationale: Official policy accelerated 5G and ZTE's operator network had already grown 16.7% in 2019.

realizedCompanyConfirmation.rationale: 2019 revenue/profit/cash flow had recovered materially before the cutoff.

crossSectionalConfirmation.rationale: The 5G basket was favorable but ZTE's final 20d relative performance was weak.

baselineLag.rationale: A current March 31 forecast quantified a strong 2020-22 EPS path.

priceAbsorption.checkMethod: Theme-level 60d excess was substantial even after a late-March ZTE correction.

priceRegime.method: equal-weight frozen opportunity basket versus CSI300 using hfq history

fundamentalImpulse.rationale: Policy and operator-network growth support continuing capex momentum.

earningsRevisionBreadth.rationale: March 31 research retained strong multi-year growth despite modest estimate cuts.

eventHalfLife.rationale: Carrier 5G buildout is a multi-quarter program.

lateCycleRisk.rationale: The theme had already delivered large 60d benchmark-relative returns.

opportunityTimingTest.rationale: Fundamentals are constructive, but expectation absorption prevents Primary status.

qualityFloor.rationale: ZTE had strong cash-flow recovery and direct operator-network exposure.

valuationSlack.rationale: The valuation framework still required a premium multiple after a large theme rerating.

catalystReachability.rationale: 5G tenders/orders and quarterly results are reachable within 60d.

downsideContainment.rationale: Large scale and cash-flow recovery help, but global COVID/supply risks remain.

earningsConversionBridge.driverChange: Official 5G acceleration plus strong 2019 operator-network growth.
earningsConversionBridge.earningsMechanism: More operator capex translates into telecom-equipment orders, revenue and operating leverage.
earningsConversionBridge.failureCondition: 5G deployment or margins fail to produce estimate upgrades above the frozen path.

baselinePath.nearTerm: 2019 operator-network revenue +16.7% and cash flow recovered.
baselinePath.rationale: March 31 report provides a current multi-period baseline.

thesisPath.nearTermChange: Accelerated domestic 5G orders can support near-term earnings.
thesisPath.nextPeriodChange: 2020 estimates can rise if deployment beats the already-strong baseline.
thesisPath.laterPeriodChange: Multi-year rollout can sustain 2021-22 growth, but this is already partly expected.
thesisPath.mechanism: Incremental alpha requires deployment speed/margins to exceed a visible 5G consensus.

incrementalPathAdvantage.rationale: The direction is strong but much of the multi-year path is already explicit in forecasts.

durationRisk.rationale: 5G is multi-year, but theme rerating creates absorption risk.

expectationPathTest.falsifier: Orders and EPS estimates do not rise beyond 1.30/1.74/2.35 as rollout proceeds.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: Research only: direct 5G earnings bridge, but large prior rerating and a visible bullish consensus path.

bearCase: 5G remains a real structural trend but the stock merely delivers already-expected growth while valuation compresses.

invalidationConditions.threshold: no upward revision beyond frozen path

caveats: All company mappings and states are frozen before outcome reveal.

nextResearchActions: Freeze ZTE as Research; do not promote solely on policy headlines.
